description: Source code implementing utilities to convert PyTorch nn.Module objects into functional representations, including extraction and loading of weights and buffers, as well as support for ensembling and functional modules with and without buffers.

classes.name: FunctionalModuleWithBuffers
classes.description: A callable object encapsulating a stateless model with parameters and buffers, supporting forward passes with replaced weights and buffers.

classes.name: FunctionalModule
classes.description: A functional wrapper around an nn.Module that allows invoking the model with external parameters.

methods.name: NoReturn raise_parameter_tying_error()
methods.description: Raises an error indicating that parameter tying or weight sharing models are not supported.

methods.name: dict[str,list[str]] create_names_map( named_params: Union[dict[str, Tensor], Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]], tied_named_params: Union[dict[str, Tensor], Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]], )
methods.description: Creates a mapping from parameter names in one set to their tied or duplicate names in another set.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[Tensor,...],tuple[str,...],dict[str,list[str]]] _extract_members( mod: nn.Module, named_members: Callable[..., Iterable[tuple[str, Tensor]]], subclass: Callable[[Tensor], Tensor], )
methods.description: Internal utility to extract parameters or buffers from a model, replace them with dummy tensors, and return original tensors with their names.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[Tensor,...],tuple[str,...],dict[str,list[str]]] extract_weights( mod: nn.Module, )
methods.description: Extracts and removes weights (parameters) from a model, returning them along with their names.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[Tensor,...],tuple[str,...],dict[str,list[str]]] extract_buffers( mod: nn.Module, )
methods.description: Extracts and removes buffers from a model, returning them along with their names.

methods.name: None load_weights( mod: nn.Module, names: Sequence[str], params: Sequence[Tensor], as_params: bool = False, )
methods.description: Loads provided weights into a model, replacing its current parameters.

methods.name: list[Tensor] _swap_state( mod: nn.Module, names_map: dict[str, list[str]], elems: Iterable[Tensor] )
methods.description: Replaces the model's parameters and/or buffers with provided tensors, returning the old state.

methods.name: None load_buffers( mod: nn.Module, names: Sequence[str], buffers: Sequence[Tensor], as_params: bool = False, )
methods.description: Loads buffers into a model, similar to weights.

methods.name: nn.Module load_state( model: nn.Module, weights: Sequence[Tensor], weight_names: Sequence[str], buffers: Sequence[Tensor] = (), buffer_names: Sequence[str] = (), )
methods.description: Loads weights and buffers into a model to restore its state.

methods.name: make_functional_deprecated_v1(model: nn.Module)
methods.description: Converts a model into a functional form by extracting weights, returning a tuple of weights, a forward function, and weight names.

methods.name: make_functional_with_buffers_deprecated_v1(model: nn.Module)
methods.description: Converts a model into a functional form including buffers, returning weights, buffers, a forward function, and their names.

methods.name: FunctionalModuleWithBuffers

methods.name: FunctionalModule
methods.description: A class representing a functional version of a model with parameters, supporting forward passes.

methods.name: tuple[FunctionalModule,tuple[Tensor,...]] make_functional( model: nn.Module, disable_autograd_tracking: bool = False )
